about.heroTitle: Making quality NEET preparation affordable for everyone
about.heroSubtitle: We help Tamil Nadu's government-school, state-board and rural students prepare for NEET — and guide those who need it toward medical seats abroad.
about.mission: To remove cost and language as barriers to NEET preparation, so every serious aspirant can practise, measure progress and improve — for the price of a bus ticket.
about.vision: A future where a student's district, board or family income never decides whether they can become a doctor.
story: VV Overseas began with a simple observation: thousands of capable students, especially from government and state-board schools, never get enough realistic practice because coaching and test series are expensive and mostly in English.
We built an affordable, mobile-first, bilingual platform where a full mock test costs just ₹30 — with clear, chapter-level feedback after every attempt.
For students who work hard but still miss a seat in India, our admission guidance team explains the honest, regulated pathways to study medicine at recognised universities abroad.

admission.heroTitle: A second pathway to your medical dream
admission.heroSubtitle: For students who work hard but don't secure a medical seat in India, we explain the honest, regulated route to studying medicine abroad.
intro: Every year many capable students narrowly miss an MBBS seat in India because of limited seats and high cut-offs. Giving up on medicine isn't the only option.
Our admission guidance service helps eligible students explore recognised medical universities in approved countries — with clear information about cost, eligibility and the rules that apply.

faq.heroSubtitle: Answers to the questions students and parents ask most.

items.q: How much does a mock test cost?
items.a: Each mock test costs ₹30. There is no subscription — you pay only for the tests you choose to attempt.

items.q: Are the tests available in Tamil?
items.a: Yes. You can take tests and read every explanation in English or Tamil, and switch language anytime.

items.q: What types of tests are available?
items.a: Previous-year pattern full tests, chapter-wise practice and year-wise practice papers.
Payments are made securely online via Razorpay. You'll need to register a free account first.

items.q: Do I get my results and analysis?
items.a: Yes. After every test you get your score plus a chapter, subject and time-wise performance analysis, with a downloadable report.

items.q: What is the admission guidance service?
items.a: For students who don't secure a medical seat in India, we advise on recognised universities abroad and clearly disclose eligibility and country-specific regulations.
No. Admission guidance is advisory. Outcomes depend on each university's criteria and the applicable regulations; we never guarantee admission.

items.q: Will the site work on a slow connection?
items.a: Yes. The platform is mobile-first and lightweight, designed to work on budget phones and rural internet.

help.heroSubtitle: Simple, step-by-step guides to register, buy a test, take a test, read your results, and reach our admission team.

sections.title: 1. Create your account
sections.intro: You only need your profile details and mobile number to start.
steps: Tap “Register” on the home page.
Enter your name, email, mobile number, location, school, class, board, and preferred language.
Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your mobile by SMS.
Your account is ready — you are taken to your dashboard.
sections.shot: The registration form with profile, school, and language fields.

sections.title: 2. Buy a mock test for ₹30
sections.intro: Every test costs just ₹30. Pay with UPI, card, or net banking.
steps: Open “Mock Tests” from the menu.
Use the filters or search box to find a test (by subject, chapter, year, or type).
Tap a test to see its syllabus, duration, and number of questions.
Tap “Buy ₹30” and complete the payment.
The test unlocks instantly and a payment confirmation appears.
sections.shot: A test card showing the ₹30 price and the Buy button.

sections.title: 3. Take a test
sections.intro: Your answers save automatically, even on a slow connection.
steps: Open a purchased test and tap “Start”.
Choose the language you want to attempt the test in.
Read each question and tap your chosen option (A, B, C, or D).
Use “Mark for Review” to flag questions to revisit.
Move between questions with Next/Previous or the question grid.
Tap “Submit” when done — the test also submits automatically when the timer ends.
sections.shot: The test screen with a question, options, timer, and question grid.

sections.title: 4. Read your results
sections.intro: See exactly where you are strong and where to improve.
steps: Your result opens as soon as you submit.
See your score and the count of correct, wrong, and skipped questions.
Check the subject and chapter analysis to spot strong and weak topics.
Review every question with the correct answer and explanation.
Download your result as a PDF to keep or share.
Open “Performance” to track your progress across all tests.
sections.shot: The result page with score, subject bars, and chapter analysis.

sections.title: 5. Contact admission guidance
sections.intro: Explore MBBS abroad and let our team guide you — for free.
steps: Open “Admission Guidance” from the menu.
Read about the study destinations, cost, and eligibility.
Fill the short form with your NEET score and preferred country.
Submit the form — our counselling team will contact you.
Track your request status on the same page any time.
sections.shot: The admission guidance form with score and country fields.

help.moreText: Our team is happy to help you in English or Tamil.
